metadata.title: fix(transports): forward passthrough headers in SSE/WebSocket loopback calls
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- SSE and WebSocket transports silently dropped client passthrough headers (e.g. `X-Upstream-Authorization`) in internal loopback `/rpc` calls, so upstream MCP servers never received them
- Added `extract_headers_for_loopback()` utility in `passthrough_headers.py` that extracts passthrough-relevant headers (always `X-Upstream-Authorization`, plus configured allowlist when enabled)
- Applied the fix in all loopback call sites: SSE endpoints, `generate_response()`, WebSocket `/ws`, and Streamable HTTP affinity forwarding paths

Closes #3640

commits.message:
fix(transports): forward passthrough headers in SSE/WebSocket/Streamable HTTP loopback calls

SSE and WebSocket transports silently dropped client passthrough headers
(e.g. X-Upstream-Authorization) when making internal loopback /rpc calls,
because only Authorization and Content-Type were forwarded. This meant
upstream MCP servers never received the client's intended headers.

Add extract_headers_for_loopback() utility that extracts passthrough-relevant
headers from incoming requests. Apply it in all loopback call sites:
- SSE /servers/{id}/sse and /sse endpoints (capture at connection time)
- SSE generate_response() (merge into loopback headers)
- WebSocket /ws endpoint (capture from handshake, merge into loopback)
- Streamable HTTP affinity forwarding paths (both sites)

Closes #3640

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(transports): harden loopback passthrough with defense-in-depth filtering, cache, and docs

- Add _LOOPBACK_SKIP_HEADERS and filter_loopback_skip_headers() to prevent
  passthrough headers from overriding gateway-internal headers (Authorization,
  Content-Type, session IDs, proxy-user identity) at loopback merge sites
- Add _LoopbackAllowlistCache with 60s TTL to avoid per-request gateway table
  scans when resolving the merged global + per-gateway passthrough allowlist
- Sanitize all extracted header values via sanitize_header_value() for CRLF
  injection defense-in-depth
- Add safe_extract_headers_for_loopback() and safe_extract_and_filter_for_loopback()
  wrappers so transport setup degrades gracefully on configuration errors
- Invalidate both global and loopback caches on all mutation paths: gateway
  create/update/delete, global config update, admin cache invalidation endpoint
- Add 52 unit tests including deny-path security tests for header override,
  proxy-user spoofing, CRLF injection, cache TTL/invalidation, and DB failure
- Update passthrough, proxy, and security-features docs with transport coverage
  table, troubleshooting notes, and loopback security description

Closes #3640

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer
